run_curate_dataset: run the curate_dataset script to process a JSONL file and generate a MetaQuery instruction dataset
build_image_caption_groups: build groups of related image-caption pairs from a JSONL document using SigLIP text similarity and maximum clique detection
generate_metaquery_prompts: generate text prompts for source-to-target image generation using Qwen2-VL with few-shot examples
calculate_similarity_matrix: calculate a caption similarity matrix using SigLIP embeddings and construct a graph for grouping related images
save_hf_dataset: save the curated image-caption-prompt pairs as a Hugging Face Dataset with proper image column casting
